description: Out-of-bounds memory access in the V8 JavaScript engine could lead to remote code execution via a crafted web page.
remediation: Update Chrome immediately and restart the browser on all user sessions.

description: A crafted archive can trigger code execution during extraction or preview workflows in older 7-Zip builds.
remediation: Upgrade 7-Zip and avoid opening archives from untrusted sources until patched.

description: A path handling flaw in archive extraction may allow execution of files outside the expected extraction path.
remediation: Install WinRAR 7.00+ and disable automatic extraction behavior in high-risk workflows.

description: Malformed media files may cause unexpected memory corruption or denial of service in outdated VLC builds.
remediation: Update VLC and restrict playback of media files downloaded from unknown sources.

description: Use-after-free in the SVG rendering path can lead to renderer process crash or code execution.
remediation: Update Firefox to 123.0 or later; restart all browser sessions.

description: Improper handling of malformed UTF-16 files may lead to memory corruption when opening crafted text files.
